vendorCommand:
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64; digest=c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64; digest=564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$arch/helm"
mkdir -p .nvkr-tools
cp "/tmp/linux-$arch/helm" .nvkr-tools/helm
export HELM_REPOSITORY_CONFIG=/tmp/nktp-repositories.yaml
export HELM_REPOSITORY_CACHE=/tmp/nktp-cache
pins="$(sha256sum nktp/deploy/charts/nktp/Chart.yaml nktp/deploy/charts/nktp/Chart.lock)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm repo add nktp-otel https://open-telemetry.github.io/opentelemetry-helm-charts
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm repo add nktp-prometheus https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm repo add nktp-metrics https://kubernetes-sigs.github.io/metrics-server/
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm dependency build nktp/deploy/charts/nktp --skip-refresh
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum -c -

  '084e6edb680cf4e2acc30bd496568c53fdf663cbacf6e17876b25785c35b7a13  nktp/deploy/charts/nktp/charts/metrics-server-3.13.1.tgz' \
  'df7d63a331d9d164a276f5b4395c6383c00fe801abcc6b2ea969de182914dc32  nktp/deploy/charts/nktp/charts/opentelemetry-kube-stack-0.22.0.tgz' \
  '70fab291e00a34c58fd943bb075fecc2e2e73fa95db1bcbbe7cdfe008795354a  nktp/deploy/charts/nktp/charts/prometheus-node-exporter-4.56.1.tgz' \

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.

test ! -e controller/deploy/charts/go.sum

vendorCommand:
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64; digest=c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64; digest=564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$arch/helm"
mkdir -p .nvkr-tools
cp "/tmp/linux-$arch/helm" .nvkr-tools/helm
export HELM_REPOSITORY_CONFIG=/tmp/nktp-repositories.yaml
export HELM_REPOSITORY_CACHE=/tmp/nktp-cache
pins="$(sha256sum nktp/deploy/charts/nktp/Chart.yaml nktp/deploy/charts/nktp/Chart.lock)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm repo add nktp-otel https://open-telemetry.github.io/opentelemetry-helm-charts
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm repo add nktp-prometheus https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm repo add nktp-metrics https://kubernetes-sigs.github.io/metrics-server/
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s .nvkr-tools/helm dependency build nktp/deploy/charts/nktp --skip-refresh
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum -c -
set -- nktp/deploy/charts/nktp/charts/*.tgz
test "$#" -eq 3
printf '%s\n' \
  '084e6edb680cf4e2acc30bd496568c53fdf663cbacf6e17876b25785c35b7a13  nktp/deploy/charts/nktp/charts/metrics-server-3.13.1.tgz' \
  'df7d63a331d9d164a276f5b4395c6383c00fe801abcc6b2ea969de182914dc32  nktp/deploy/charts/nktp/charts/opentelemetry-kube-stack-0.22.0.tgz' \
  '70fab291e00a34c58fd943bb075fecc2e2e73fa95db1bcbbe7cdfe008795354a  nktp/deploy/charts/nktp/charts/prometheus-node-exporter-4.56.1.tgz' \
  | sha256sum -c -

buildCommand:
mkdir -p bin/profiles-context/profiles/configProfiles
cp controller/test/fixtures/profiles/configProfiles/nico-vms-cp.yaml \
  controller/test/fixtures/profiles/configProfiles/nico-vms-worker.yaml bin/profiles-context/profiles/configProfiles/
cp -R controller/test/fixtures/runbooks bin/profiles-context/
buildctl-daemonless.sh build --frontend dockerfile.v0 \
  --local context=/src/bin/profiles-context \
  --local dockerfile=/src/controller/test/fixtures \
  --opt 'platform=linux/{{.Arch}}' \
  --opt context:alpine:3.24.1=docker-image://docker.io/library/alpine@sha256:294b683cb724975bec92580e1e685676bd4b50bda910ddb8c51d4cabeaec77e6 \
  --opt "build-arg:SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" \
  --output 'type=oci,dest=/src/bin/nico-reference-profiles-fixture-{{.Arch}}.oci.tar,oci-mediatypes=true,rewrite-timestamp=true'
